conflicts.title: V2 speed overstated by witness W1
conflicts.description: W1 estimates the SUV at 'at least 80 km/h'; V2 OBD records a steady 57.6 km/h before braking.

conflicts.title: Northbound signal state disputed
conflicts.description: W1 says V1's light was green on approach. The signal controller and dashcam both show yellow from t≈7 s; V1 entered at t≈10 s. W2 agrees it was yellow.

conflicts.title: W2 claims V1 accelerated; telemetry shows braking
conflicts.description: W2 says the red car 'sped up to beat the light'. V1 telematics shows constant 46.8 km/h, then braking from t=9.0 s.

conflicts.title: W2's incident time does not overlap sensor time
conflicts.description: W2 puts the crash at about 17:45 (±2 min); sensors place the collision at 17:42:10. W1's ~17:40 (±5 min) is consistent.

conflicts.title: V1 telematics dropout during yellow onset
conflicts.description: No V1 records between t=6.0 s and t=7.5 s, exactly when the northbound signal changed to yellow. V1's reaction to the yellow cannot be confirmed from telemetry.

conflicts.title: No direct view of V2's signal
conflicts.description: V2's red-light entry is inferred from the controller log only. The dashcam cannot see the eastbound signal and W2 did not see it.

conflicts.title: V2 vehicle type ambiguous
conflicts.description: W2 is unsure whether V2 was an SUV or a van; dashcam and W1 say SUV.
